## Privacy check

Do not upload supout.rif/autosupout.rif, configuration backups, support bundles, credentials or unredacted logs here. Request a private channel first. Remove IP/MAC addresses, serials, hostnames and customer details. Do not reproduce a crash on production just to complete this form.

## Environment

- Driver version and VIB SHA-256:
- ESXi build:
- RouterOS and RouterBOOT versions:
- Server model and card count:
- Native host or PCI assignment to guest (all functions?):
- RouterOS passthrough mode, if used:
- ESXi MTU / RouterOS L2MTU:
- Independent management/recovery path available:

## Problem

- Expected behavior:
- Observed behavior:
- Minimal steps already performed:
- Timestamp and timezone:
- Does RouterOS uptime change?
- Do new connections/ping work?
- Is more than one function affected?

## Evidence

Paste only a short, redacted incident excerpt and relevant package/NIC state. State which artifact was actually installed. Mention that private diagnostics are available without attaching them. See SUPPORT.md and VALIDATION.md.
